newsitem.title: USA: Callaway Golf gets judgment in British case.
newsitem.headline: Callaway Golf gets judgment in British case.

text.p: Callaway Golf Co said on Monday a British court granted summary judgment and an injunction against Swiss trading company SofTrading AG and one of its representatives related to imitation golf clubs.

Callaway said it filed a civil action in Britain in November 1996, charging that the Swingline "Big Brother" and "Great Big Brother" metal woods and "Big Brother" irons marketed by SofTrading illegally copied some Callaway clubs.

The court gave summary judgment to Callaway on all its registered design claims and all but one of its trademark claims and entered an interlocutory injunction to prevent any further activity by defendants on the remaining claim.
The Court also awarded Callaway Golf its legal fees, the company said. SofTrading could no longer sell its Swingline clubs in Britain, the company said.
